hooks.name: Quick Security Scan on Save
hooks.description: Run a quick Strix security scan when Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript files are saved

then.prompt: A file was just modified. Run a quick Strix security scan (strix -n -t ./ --scan-mode quick --max-budget 3) to check for vulnerabilities introduced by this change. If vulnerabilities are found, summarize them and suggest fixes.

hooks.name: Post-Task Security Validation
hooks.description: Automatically run security tests after completing a development task

hooks.name: Pre-Commit Security Gate
hooks.description: Manual trigger to run security checks before committing code

hooks.name: Security Review Before PR
hooks.description: Run comprehensive security scan before creating pull requests

hooks.name: API Endpoint Security Check
hooks.description: Scan API routes and controllers for security vulnerabilities

then.prompt: An API endpoint file was modified. Run Strix with focus on API security (strix -n -t ./ --instruction 'Focus on API security: broken authentication, excessive data exposure, injection, broken access control' --max-budget 5). Report any findings.

hooks.name: Authentication Code Review
hooks.description: Deep security scan when authentication/authorization code changes

then.prompt: Authentication or authorization code was modified. This is critical. Run a focused Strix scan (strix -n -t ./ --instruction 'Focus on authentication bypass, session management, privilege escalation, and access control flaws' --max-budget 10). Review findings carefully.

hooks.name: Database Query Security
hooks.description: Check for SQL/NoSQL injection when database code changes

then.prompt: Database query code was modified. Run Strix with injection focus (strix -n -t ./ --instruction 'Focus exclusively on SQL injection, NoSQL injection, and ORM security issues' --max-budget 5).

hooks.name: Weekly Deep Security Audit
hooks.description: Comprehensive weekly security audit (trigger manually or via cron)

hooks.name: Review Security Tool Output
hooks.description: Review and summarize Strix scan results after completion

then.prompt: A command was just executed. If it was a Strix scan, check the results in strix_runs/ and provide a summary of findings, their severity, and recommended next steps.
